John, Kate, Jack, Emma—since I’m the newcomer, let me sit out this month while you four take 13 tons each. That’s $13,000 apiece and 52 tons total, all going to you. We’d leave 48 tons, which doubles to 96 next month, so this is a modest one-month drawdown rather than a proposal to empty the lake. Next month we could bring it back to 100 by limiting the total catch to 46 tons.

I’m asking each of you to actually choose 13 tons this month, and I’ll choose zero. It gives everyone already established here an equal payout while I demonstrate that I’ll honor an agreement. John, will you take 13 and help me get Kate, Jack, and Emma on board?
